name: Dreaded Presence (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Frightful presence, Ability Focus (frightful presence), Intimidate 7 ranks, Cha 13

Benefit(s): If a subject fails its save against your frightful presence it is frightened regardless of its Hit Dice. Creatures that make their saves are shaken for 1 round.
